title: Sage (Salvia officinalis) alleviates trazadone induced rat cardiotoxicity mediated via modulation of autophagy and oxidative stress.
disposition: Rat sage oil and trazodone cardiac toxicity; insomnia is drug indication, not measured sleep

title: The effect of Salvia officinalis extract on symptoms of flushing, night sweat, sleep disorders, and score of forgetfulness in postmenopausal women.
disposition: Postmenopausal randomized oral sage extract versus placebo with PSQI and sleep-related MRS outcomes; existing catalog

title: Effectiveness of Menosan® Salvia officinalis in the treatment of a wide spectrum of menopausal complaints. A double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled, clinical trial.
disposition: Randomized fresh-sage ethanolic extract versus placebo in menopausal women with sleep and fatigue outcomes; existing catalog

title: [Treatment of neurovegetative menopausal symptoms with a phytotherapeutic agent].
disposition: Uncontrolled menopausal sage plus alfalfa extract treatment reports hot flushes and night sweats, not isolated sage or quantified insomnia

title: Salvia officinalis L. attenuates morphine analgesic tolerance and dependence in rats: possible analgesic and sedative mechanisms.
disposition: Original abstract reports sedation-related sleep duration in a morphine rat model. Group estimates, units and full protocol remain unverified. No clinical insomnia comparison.

title: Neuroprotective Potential of Aromatic Herbs: Rosemary, Sage, and Lavender.
disposition: Original review describes sleep measurements in aromatherapy evidence for other oils. The sage material concerns neuroprotection and cognition without an assigned dried-sage insomnia comparison.
